summary_en: This study tests pembrolizumab added to the chemotherapy drugs gemcitabine and cisplatin, given before and after surgery, in people with potentially resectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. All three drugs are given by IV (into a vein) in 4 cycles of 21 days each, during 9 months of chemotherapy. The main aim is to see whether adding pembrolizumab improves long-term response after surgery, compared with surgery and standard chemotherapy alone.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba pembrolizumab agregado a los medicamentos quimioterapéuticos gemcitabina y cisplatino, administrados antes y después de la cirugía, en personas con colangiocarcinoma intrahepático potencialmente resecable. Los tres medicamentos se administran por vía intravenosa (en una vena), en 4 ciclos de 21 días cada uno, durante 9 meses de quimioterapia. El objetivo principal es saber si agregar pembrolizumab mejora la respuesta a largo plazo después de la cirugía, en comparación con la cirugía y la quimioterapia estándar sola.
who_for: Age 18 or older and able to give written informed consent
Confirmed intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma that can be measured on scans
High-risk but resectable tumor limited to the liver, bile duct, and/or regional lymph nodes
Adequate blood counts, liver function, and kidney function
not_for: Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, or anti-PD-L2 therapy, or other T-cell checkpoint therapy
Previous systemic therapy for intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
Small cell, neuroendocrine, lymphoma, sarcoma, mixed histology, or mucinous cystic neoplasm
Active central nervous system metastases or carcinomatous meningitis
Active hepatitis B and hepatitis C infection together
